SELECT idx,cate_lv1 ,cate_lv2 ,RTRIM(prod_code + ' ' + prod_option1) as prod_code ,RTRIM(prod_code + ' ' + prod_option1) as prod_name ,cate_lv2 as prod_desc, prod_option1 ,prod_others ,eco_category ,sample_modify ,bottle_5K ,Innerbottle_5K ,pumpcap_5K ,cap_5K ,tubesleeveheadering_5K ,others_5K ,set_5K ,bottle_10K ,Innerbottle_10K ,pumpcap_10K ,cap_10K ,tubesleeveheadering_10K ,others_10K ,set_10K ,bottle_30K ,Innerbottle_30K ,pumpcap_30K ,cap_30K ,tubesleeveheadering_30K ,others_30K ,set_30K ,bottle_50K ,Innerbottle_50K ,pumpcap_50K ,cap_50K ,tubesleeveheadering_50K ,others_50K ,set_50K ,bottle_100K ,Innerbottle_100K ,pumpcap_100K ,cap_100K ,tubesleeveheadering_100K ,others_100K ,set_100K ,remark ,create_id ,create_date ,modify_id ,modify_date ,del_yn FROM T_BASE_PRODUCT WHERE ISNULL(del_yn,'N') = 'N'
AND idx = #idx#
AND cate_lv1 = #cate_lv1#
AND cate_lv2 = #cate_lv2#
AND prod_code LIKE '%' + #prod_code# + '%'
SELECT catenm, catenm as cd FROM ( SELECT distinct cate_lv1 as catenm FROM T_BASE_PRODUCT WHERE ISNULL(del_yn,'N') = 'N' ) A
SELECT catenm, catenm as cd FROM ( SELECT distinct cate_lv2 as catenm FROM T_BASE_PRODUCT WHERE ISNULL(del_yn,'N') = 'N' AND cate_lv1 = #cate_lv1# AND cate_lv2 like '%' + #cate_lv2# + '%') A

SELECT A.idx ,A.prod_code ,A.prod ,A.sub_prod , A.prod_option ,A.prod_option as prod_name, A.sub_prod as prod_desc ,isnull(A.global_basic,0) as global_basic ,isnull(A.global_sample,0) as global_sample ,isnull(A.japan_basic,0) as japan_basic ,isnull(A.japan_sample,0) as japan_sample ,A.remark ,A.create_id ,A.create_date ,A.modify_id ,A.modify_date ,A.del_yn FROM T_BASE_OPTION A, T_OPTION_SPEC_SHEET B WHERE ISNULL(A.del_yn,'N') = 'N' AND A.prod = B.prod AND A.sub_prod = B.sub_prod AND A.prod_option = B.prod_option
AND A.idx = #idx#
AND B.prod_code = #prod_code#
AND A.sub_prod LIKE '%' + #sub_prod# + '%'
AND A.prod_option LIKE '%' + #prod_option# + '%'

SELECT idx ,estimate_id ,form_lang ,form_type ,form_id ,dstr_type , dstr_type as dstr_chn, user_cd ,user_nm,status_cd, case when status_cd = '0' then '임시' when status_cd = '1' then '상신' when status_cd = '2' then '승인' else '반려' end AS status_nm ,prod_code, prod_name, item_name, item_qty ,CONVERT(CHAR(10), estimate_date, 20) as estimate_date ,cust_cd ,cust_nm, ref_cd ,ref_nm ,submit_cd ,submit_nm ,currency ,subject ,summary_yn ,remark ,create_id ,CONVERT(CHAR(19), create_date, 20) as create_date ,modify_id ,CONVERT(CHAR(19), modify_date, 20) as modify_date ,del_yn FROM T_ESTIMATE_HEAD WHERE ISNULL(del_yn,'N') = 'N'
AND idx = #idx#
AND estimate_id = #estimate_id#
AND form_lang = #form_lang#
AND form_type = #form_type#
AND form_id = #form_id#
AND user_cd = #user_cd#
AND ref_cd = #ref_cd#
AND submit_cd = #submit_cd#
AND dstr_type = #dstr_type#
AND status_cd = #status_cd#
AND user_nm LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%'
AND cust_nm LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%'
AND subject LIKE '%' + #subject# + '%'

select convert(varchar(4), datepart(year, getdate())) + right('0'+convert(varchar(2), datepart(month, getdate())),2) + right('000' + convert(varchar(4), convert(int, right(isnull(max(estimate_id),1),4)) + 1),4) from T_ESTIMATE_HEAD where left(estimate_id,6) = convert(varchar(4), datepart(year, getdate())) + right('0'+convert(varchar(2), datepart(month, getdate())),2)
